```{r}

source("lib/ggplot/switchbox_theme.R")
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)


supply_rates_raw = read_csv("/workspaces/reports/data/utility_rates/electric/ConEd/ConEd - LDS_APPND.csv", skip = 1) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  filter(type == "1") |>
  rename(
    from_dt = x2,
    to_dt = x3,
    trip = x4,
    all_hours_h = `lt_zone_h_5`,
    on_peak_h = `lt_zone_h_7`,
    off_peak_h = `lt_zone_h_9`,
    all_hours_i = `lt_zone_i_11`,
    on_peak_i = `lt_zone_i_13`,
    off_peak_i = `lt_zone_i_15`,
    all_hours_j = `lt_zone_j_17`,
    on_peak_j = `lt_zone_j_19`,
    off_peak_j = `lt_zone_j_21`
  ) |>
  mutate(
    from_dt = ymd(from_dt),
    to_dt = ymd(to_dt)
  )|>
  mutate(
    start_year = year(from_dt),
    start_month = month(from_dt),
    start_day = day(from_dt)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    utility = "coned"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean by month
supply_rates <- supply_rates_raw |>
  select(
    all_hours_h,
    on_peak_h,
    off_peak_h,
    all_hours_i,
    on_peak_i,
    off_peak_i,
    all_hours_j,
    on_peak_j,
    off_peak_j,
    start_month,
    start_year
  ) |>
  # ConEd provides different supply rates for 1-month periods, but starting each day of the month,
  # ie 365 different supply rates in each year, with each rate covering a 30-day period from "start_day"
  # We'll take the average all all the rates for a given "start_month" to get a single rate for that month
  group_by(start_month, start_year) |>
  summarize(
    all_hours_h = mean(all_hours_h),
    on_peak_h = mean(on_peak_h),
    off_peak_h = mean(off_peak_h),
    all_hours_i = mean(all_hours_i),
    on_peak_i = mean(on_peak_i),
    off_peak_i = mean(off_peak_i),
    all_hours_j = mean(all_hours_j),
    on_peak_j = mean(on_peak_j),
    off_peak_j = mean(off_peak_j),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(start_year, start_month) |>
  mutate(
    month = start_month,
    year = start_year
  ) |>
  select(-c(start_month, start_year)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(month, year),
    names_to = "name",
    values_to = "rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    utility = "coned"
  )

# Save to CSV
write_csv(
  supply_rates,
  "/workspaces/reports/data/utility_rates/electric/ConEd/coned_supply_rates.csv"
)


# Add to database
path_rs_db <- "data/ResStock/2022_resstock_amy2018_release_1.1/rs_ny_coned_hp_rates.db"
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), path_rs_db)
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "supply_rates", supply_rates, overwrite = TRUE)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)


```
